claims.text: DETR represents detections using a fixed set of learned object queries, predicting a class including a no-object category and a normalized bounding box for each query.
claims.notes: DETR constructs nn.Embedding(num_queries, hidden_dim), a num_classes+1 classification head, and a bounding-box MLP whose sigmoid outputs are normalized to [0,1]. This is a source-reviewed development annotation, not a verbatim PDF quotation. The original PDF could not be downloaded in this environment; no PDF page or character offsets have been invented.

claims.notes: HungarianMatcher combines all three costs in C and calls scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment separately for each image. claims.notes: SetCriterion.loss_boxes indexes matched prediction/target pairs, computes F.l1_loss and 1-generalized_box_iou, and normalizes their sums by the number of boxes.
